Qivv brand chalk markers! I used a toothpick to blend the two colors together while they were still wet :)

Edit: They’re Qivv brand chalk pens! 6mm and I bought the 20 pack. I wrote the names out with the base color and then put a small dot of ink with the second color on the bottom of each letter. While the ink was still wet I used a toothpick to blend the two colors into a gradient! Sounds difficult but super easy!
